title: SqCOT symbol-map.csv schema 1

columns.name: broker_server
columns.description: Exact MT5 server, or * for global scope

columns.name: aliases_direct
columns.description: Exact case-insensitive CFD aliases separated by |; may be empty

columns.name: aliases_inverse
columns.description: Exact aliases with inverse quote orientation; raw values unchanged

columns.name: note
columns.description: Free text; quote semicolons, newlines and double quotes using CSV rules

constraints: Each alias unique within a server across both orientations and all markets
Broker alias overrides global alias; disabled matching broker alias blocks fallback
installation: Reference only. Service creates the runtime CSV; do not overwrite existing custom configuration.
